system.description:
Battle Amp

While in this state, you gain the following benefits;

Two Steps Ahead. At the beginning of each of your turns, you regain either 2 White Chakra or 1 Command Dice.

Lethal Fang. Once per turn, when you score a hit with an attack that deals damage of a type associated with your Passive Affinity, you can remove 1 rank of the conditions associated condition to reinforce the attack, granting it a rank of mastery to its critical threat range. (Earth: Bruised/Dazed, Wind: Bleed/Weakened, Fire: Burned, Cold: Chilled, Lightning: Shocked)

Limit Break. Once per turn, You can spend 3 White Chakra or 2 Command Dice to gain an additional action. Once you do, you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

No Casualties. When an allied creature other than yourself within 30 feet of you would take damage, you can spend your reaction to deflect some of the damage, throwing your weapon to intercept and reducing the damage they would take by an amount equal to your [Weapon Damage] + your level. You throw your weapon and it lands on the ground in a space next to damaged ally.
system.summary: Regain White Chakra or Command Dice each turn, crit Mastery from your affinity, an extra action, and a reaction to protect an ally.
